title: Value Frontier — Strategic Rebranding
jpTitle: Value Frontier — 戦略的リブランディング

summary.en: Led the rebrand of Value Frontier, a sustainability consultancy expanding into high-end fashion and other industries, from brand DNA development through stylescapes to full applications — corporate collateral, environmental signage, digital and print. The brand essence developed here later became the foundation for the DO! NUTS TOKYO sub-brand, a 2021 AGDA winner.
summary.jp: Value Frontier の事業拡大を手がけた。核づくりから実際の適用物まで一貫して担当した。その核は後に DO! NUTS TOKYO の土台になった。2021 年の AGDA を受賞している。

business.en: The brand essence developed for Value Frontier's own repositioning later became the seed for an entirely separate sub-brand, DO! NUTS TOKYO, which went on to win a 2021 American Graphic Design Award.
business.jp: Value Frontier 自身の再定義用に作ったブランドの核がある。それが後に姉妹ブランド DO! NUTS TOKYO の種になった。そちらは 2021 年の AGDA を受賞した。

mine: Led the rebrand from brand DNA development through stylescapes to full design applications
Uncovered the firm's core values and strategic aspirations and translated them into a visual language that read as 'both premium and purposeful'
Designed the identity system to work across corporate collateral, environmental signage, digital platforms and print
team: Client executive team, visual designers, and a web designer/developer — credited on the page without individual task breakdown

label.en: sub-brand launched from this rebrand, 2021 AGDA winner
label.jp: 姉妹ブランドが AGDA 受賞

narrative.problem: Value Frontier had established itself as a sustainability consulting firm, but its ambitions had outgrown its identity — the existing visual identity no longer reflected the caliber of clients it was attracting or the breadth of its strategic capabilities.

_notes: Engagement recorded as freelance based on roles.json's cie evidence list, which includes value-frontier.
